description: This file defines an Android activity that demonstrates usage of various view animations such as alpha, translate, rotate, scale, and combination animations. It includes setup for buttons to trigger these animations and loads some animations from resource files.

classes.name: ViewAnimations
classes.description: An Android Activity that demonstrates multiple view animations including alpha, translate, rotate, scale, and combination animations triggered by buttons.

methods.name: onCreate
methods.description: Initializes the activity, sets up buttons, and assigns animations to each button, including a combined animation set.

methods.name: setupAnimation
methods.description: Configures a click listener for a view to trigger the specified animation, either loading from XML resource or using the provided animation object based on checkbox state.
